name: language-select
purpose: A searchable picker for the interface language: a `Select` whose trigger and rows show each language's flag and its name in that language (`English`, `Português (Brasil)`, `Español`), with a search box at the top of the list that filters by language name, BCP 47 tag or country. `v-model` holds the BCP 47 tag of the picked language, ready to hand to `ConfigProvider`'s `locale`. It offers the languages WebKit ships catalogs for (`en`, `pt-BR`, `es`) and takes the consumer's own list through `options`. It is the language counterpart of the country picker inside `phone-input`, and reuses its flag sprite and search behaviour.
useWhen: A language switch for the whole app or a page: a header, a footer, a settings page or a sign-in screen.
A form field that asks which language a user, a page or a notification is written in.
avoidWhen: Two or three languages that must stay visible side by side on a toolbar → use `toggle-group`.
Picking a country (for a phone number, an address) → use `phone-input` or `select`.
Setting the language of WebKit's own strings → that is `config-provider`'s `locale`; bind this picker's `v-model` to it.
related: `config-provider` — takes the picked tag as `locale` and translates everything below it.
`select` — the picker this component is built on; use it directly for any other list of choices.
`phone-input` — the same flag sprite and searchable list, for the dial code of a phone number.
`field` — wraps the picker with a label and a description when it sits in a form.
bestPractices: Bind `v-model` to the same value as `ConfigProvider`'s `locale`, so the picker and the strings move together.
Name languages in their own language (`Português (Brasil)`, not `Portuguese (Brazil)`): a reader who cannot read the current language still finds theirs.

Give each option a `country` only when it tells regional variants apart or the tag has no region (`en` → `US`); a flag stands for a country, never for a language on its own, so the name always sits next to it.
Put it in a `Field` with a `Field.Label` in a form; on a toolbar or a footer, give it an `aria-label` only if the built-in `Language` name does not fit.

props.name: options
props.doc: Languages offered, in order: `{ value, label, country? }` where `value` is a BCP 47 tag, `label` the language named in itself, and `country` the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the flag (taken from the tag's region when omitted).

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Trigger text while no language is picked. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Language`).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token forwarded to the Select trigger. Heights: small=28px, medium=32px, large=40px.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the trigger and keeps the list closed.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the trigger when no Field labels it. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Language`).

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Search language`).

props.name: emptyTitle
props.doc: Shown in the list when no language matches the search. Empty uses the locale catalog (`No language found.`).
